reservations_range_bounded.name: reservations_range_bounded
reservations_range_bounded.value: NOT isempty("reservations"."occupied_range") AND lower_inf("reservations"."occupied_range") = false AND upper_inf("reservations"."occupied_range") = false

offers_scope_ref.name: offers_scope_ref
offers_scope_ref.value: ("offers"."scope_type" = 'practitioner' AND "offers"."practitioner_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("offers"."scope_type" = 'clinic' AND "offers"."clinic_id" IS NOT NULL)

reviews_text_len.name: reviews_text_len
reviews_text_len.value: "reviews"."text" IS NULL OR char_length("reviews"."text") BETWEEN 20 AND 2000
